faq.q: How does the AI image background changer work?
faq.a: It finds the product in your photo and can remove or replace the room behind it. A blue ceramic vase on a messy counter can come back on pale wood, and the vase stays the one you sell.

faq.q: Where do I get backgrounds for a product photo?
faq.a: Pick a ready setting, such as pale wood or a shaded garden table, or describe a surface in one short line.

faq.q: What should I check before I trust a background changer?
faq.a: Check the vase rim against the photo you uploaded. The new setting should leave the shape and the color alone, and the credit cost is on screen before the photo is made.

faq.q: How do I put a new setting behind a product photo?
faq.a: Upload the vase photo and name one surface, such as pale wood. You get a square with that wood filled in behind the vase, ready to put on the listing.

faq.q: How do I swap the room behind a product photo?
faq.a: Upload the product photo. The old room comes off, and you can place white, a studio table, or a setting you name behind it. You download a finished photo.

faq.q: Can I make a new background for an Etsy photo?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one vase photo, name the surface or the room, and download the square. The cost shows before the job starts, and a failed job returns those credits.
The vase should keep its angle, color, and shape. Small printed words can shift, so compare the result with the photo you uploaded before you list it.

faq.q: Can the new photo become a video with a voice?
faq.a: Yes. Open a moving clip from the vase photo, or start from a product link. Add a written script, a spoken voice, captions, and music, then publish a tall cut on TikTok or a square on Meta. You can add a short line in another language in the editor.

faq.q: Can I run several backgrounds from one photo?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for a studio surface, a wood counter, and a garden table from the same vase photo. You can run them as a batch. Each photo is 24 credits, shown before you start. Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I use the new photo in a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. The download has no watermark. You can use it for your business. Add any price or offer in your ad editor after you download.
